component.name: Vice
component.summary: Save the last few minutes of your game with one key

description.p: Vice keeps a rolling buffer of your screen and saves the last few seconds or minutes as a clip when you press a key. Clips get a gallery, a timeline editor and share links.
The Flatpak is in beta. It records with the gpu-screen-recorder Flatpak, which Vice offers to install the first time it opens.
